metadata.title: Quantitative DIA-based proteomic analysis of lysosomes (Lyso-IP) from VPS35[D620N] Mouse Brain.
metadata.description: Proteomic characterization of brain lysosomes comparing WT and VPS35[D620N] mutant mice. Tissue was processed via glass-Teflon homogenization and 3-minute Lyso-IP. Data acquired on an Orbitrap Exploris 480 and processed using DIA-NN 1.8.1.
